verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents first-party webhooks that send real-time push notifications when events occur in your account. They are delivered as HTTP POST requests with a JSON payload to your URL, which is a registrable outbound callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence covers only the overview level, so subscription mechanics are not detailed. Missing for 10: documented event-type selection/subscription management, signature verification and retry/delivery-guarantee details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
